Week 23, October 7, 2026 in St. Petersburg

Week 23-- General Conference!

First of all, my brother (who is writing this email on my behalf, since I was too tired and it is after 10:30) is, in his words, the funniest, most throwable, statuesque and elegant person I've ever met.

We had a cool lesson tonight while doing phone contacting. We were about to text one of our referrals when I had an impression that we needed to call him. Miracle number one: he actually picked up after a few failed contacts. Miracle number two: he's actually interested. He told us that he wants to find God's truth and God's church. I would like to emphasize how old this guy is: he's forty-two, so texting is hard for him, but he has a bunch of questions that he hasn't been able to find answers to and we have a lesson scheduled now. Some creepy homebound member called us this week and told us he was the reason there hadn't been sisters in the ward for five years. We blocked him and are unsure about why he called other than to let us know he's creepy. Fortunately he is permanently homebound so there will be no public interactions.

The weather has been very humid and rainy. A blessing I've seen though is that I haven't had a heat-induced headache since I got here, even though I used to get them all the time if I had to play soccer in the heat or the sun. Even riding bikes hasn't been a problem, which is a real miracle, especially since we're in a partially-bike area again this transfer.

We went to a bird park for p-day. The birds were expected, as was the park, fortunately. No daggers or cheese were involved with this park, but I did get to see the ocean for a while, right where the mission boundaries end. Pierce disagrees with President about where the mission boundaries end: President says the mission ends where sand begins, but Pierce thinks there are still valuable contacting opportunities all the way 12 miles out to the international boundary.

Until white shores, and beyond, a far green country under a swift sunrise, Sister Christison
